arguments.sql:
WITH LatestPayRate AS (
    SELECT 
        businessentityid,
        rate,
        ratechangedate
    FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory eph1
    WHERE ratechangedate = (
        SELECT MAX(ratechangedate)
        FROM humanresources.employeepayhistory eph2
        WHERE eph2.businessentityid = eph1.businessentityid
    )
),
ActiveEmployeeDepartments AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        edh.businessentityid,
        d.departmentid,
        d.name AS department_name
    FROM humanresources.employeedepartmenthistory edh
    INNER JOIN humanresources.department d ON edh.departmentid = d.departmentid
    WHERE edh.enddate IS NULL
)
SELECT 
    ed.department_name AS department,
    p.lastname,
    lpr.rate,
    CUME_DIST() OVER (
        PARTITION BY ed.department_name 
        ORDER BY lpr.rate
    ) AS cumulative_distribution,
    PERCENT_RANK() OVER (
        PARTITION BY ed.department_name 
        ORDER BY lpr.rate
    ) AS percent_rank
FROM person.person p
INNER JOIN humanresources.employee e ON p.businessentityid = e.businessentityid
INNER JOIN LatestPayRate lpr ON e.businessentityid = lpr.businessentityid
INNER JOIN ActiveEmployeeDepartments ed ON e.businessentityid = ed.businessentityid
WHERE ed.department_name IN ('Information Services', 'Document Control')
ORDER BY ed.department_name ASC, lpr.rate DESC;
